fixes.title: Overcooked
fixes.notes: 32-bit Unity 5.5 game, DirectX 11. Starts and reaches the main menu through DXVK since G-Player 0.3.5, which puts MoltenVK 1.4.2 into Wine Staging (1.4.0 refused the memory Wine makes for 32-bit programs); gameplay not checked yet. In the Compatible profile (WineD3D) it crashes in its own code. Tested 2026-10-22 on an M5 Mac with macOS 26.4.

fixes.title: Cossacks 3
fixes.notes: 32-bit OpenGL game that asks for OpenGL 4.4 with the compatibility profile. macOS offers OpenGL 4.1 core at most, so it stops with "Your video card does not support hardware acceleration". CrossOver lists it as not running on a Mac too. Tested 2026-10-22 on an M5 Mac with macOS 26.4.
